An icon change. No code changes: the server, its tools and the way credentials are
stored are exactly those of v4.3.2.

## A drawing of our own

The bundle shipped the official Garmin Connect app icon. Using another company's
artwork to represent an extension nobody at that company published is a poor idea
regardless of who notices — it invites the reader to assume the extension is a
Garmin product, and this one is an independent client for a personal account.

The replacement is an original drawing: a runner over an arc, in blue on a dark
rounded square. It carries no logo and no trademark. The name still says Garmin
Connect, because that is the service the extension talks to.

## Transparent, not white

The area around the rounded square is transparent. The previous file was opaque
white, which shows as a white box around the icon anywhere it is drawn on a dark
surface.

## Install

Download `garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb` and open it with Claude Desktop, or drag it onto
Settings → Extensions. Verify the download first:

```
sha256sum -c garmin-mcp-ts.mcpb.sha256
```

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/sedoglia/garmin-mcp-ts/compare/v4.3.2...v4.3.3
